mapper.select: SELECT fee_type_id, fee_code, fee_name FROM fee_type WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY fee_name, fee_type_id
mapper.sql: WHERE 1 = 1 AND fs.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0 AND fs.community_id = #{query.communityId} AND fs.status = #{query.status}
mapper.select: SELECT fs.fee_standard_id, c.community_name, ft.fee_name, ft.billing_method, fs.unit_price, ft.unit_name, fs.effective_from, fs.effective_to, fs.status FROM fee_standard fs JOIN community c ON c.community_id = fs.community_id JOIN fee_type ft ON ft.fee_type_id = fs.fee_type_id ORDER BY c.community_code, ft.fee_code, fs.effective_from DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: FROM payment pay JOIN bill b ON b.bill_id = pay.bill_id JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = b.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building bl ON bl.building_id = bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id = bl.community_id JOIN person p ON p.person_id = pay.payer_person_id

WHERE 1 = 1 AND c.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0 AND c.community_id = #{query.communityId} AND pay.status = #{query.status} AND pay.payment_method = #{query.paymentMethod} AND b.billing_year = #{query.year} AND b.billing_month = #{query.month}
mapper.select: SELECT pay.payment_id, pay.payment_no, b.bill_no, c.community_name, CONCAT(c.community_name, ' · ', bl.building_no, '号楼 · ', COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')), ' · ', pu.property_no) AS full_location, p.full_name AS payer_name, pay.amount, pay.paid_at, pay.payment_method, pay.status ORDER BY pay.paid_at DESC, pay.payment_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: FROM v_bill_financial_summary v JOIN property_unit pu ON pu.property_unit_id = v.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id = pu.building_unit_id JOIN building bl ON bl.building_id = bu.building_id JOIN community c ON c.community_id = bl.community_id
WHERE v.status = 'OVERDUE' AND c.community_id IN #{scopeId} AND 1 = 0 AND c.community_id = #{query.communityId} AND v.billing_year = #{query.year} AND v.billing_month = #{query.month}
mapper.select: SELECT pu.property_unit_id, CONCAT(c.community_name, ' · ', bl.building_no, '号楼 · ', COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')), ' · ', pu.property_no) AS full_location, SUM(v.outstanding_amount) AS outstanding_amount, COUNT(*) AS overdue_bill_count GROUP BY pu.property_unit_id, c.community_name, bl.building_no, bu.unit_name, bu.unit_no, pu.property_no ORDER BY outstanding_amount DESC, overdue_bill_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT v.bill_id, v.bill_no, c.community_name, CONCAT(c.community_name, ' · ', bl.building_no, '号楼 · ', COALESCE(bu.unit_name, CONCAT(bu.unit_no, '单元')), ' · ', pu.property_no) AS full_location, v.billing_year, v.billing_month, v.receivable_amount, v.received_amount, v.outstanding_amount, v.due_date ORDER BY v.outstanding_amount DESC, v.due_date ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
